name: Pressmark
what: An installable web app that gives anyone all 33 iLovePDF-style tools (merge, compress, OCR, convert, sign, redact, compare and more) with every file processed on their own device.
hard_part: Everything that normally needs a server runs in the browser: pdf.js and pdf-lib for page work, qpdf compiled to WebAssembly for repair, tesseract for OCR with an invisible text layer, and Office-to-PDF by painting the document in the DOM. A service worker precaches about 8 MB so the tools work offline.
facts: Each tool run against a real fixture file, not a hello-world PDF
Compress: 5.7 MB to 628 KB on a photo PDF, text untouched
Repair recovers 8 of 8 pages on both damaged fixtures
